title: Onboard a New Developer
description: Create a fully configured local account for a new developer and add it to the developers group.
scenario: A new platform engineer named Amara Okafor starts today. HR has raised the standard onboarding ticket: create her local account on the shared staging box, give her a bash shell with a home directory, put her GECOS comment in the standard 'Full Name - Team' format, add her to the developers group and set a temporary password she must change on first login.
symptoms: There is no amara account on the server yet
The developers group already exists but has no new members
The onboarding ticket requires the GECOS comment 'Amara Okafor - Platform Team'
Without an account Amara cannot even SSH into the staging box
mission: Create the amara account with a home directory and bash shell, set the GECOS comment, add her to the developers group and set a temporary password.

hints.title: Create, don't edit
hints.content: Use `useradd -m` — the `-m` flag creates /home/<name> and copies the skeleton files. Never edit /etc/passwd directly.

hints.title: GECOS comment
hints.content: The `-c` flag of useradd sets the comment (real name) field: `-c "Amara Okafor - Platform Team"`.

hints.title: Append to a group
hints.content: `usermod -aG developers amara` — the `-a` (append) is critical: without it you REPLACE all her groups.

hints.title: Temporary password
hints.content: `echo 'amara:ChangeMe123!' | sudo chpasswd` sets the password non-interactively.

acceptance_criteria.description: amara has a bash shell and the correct GECOS comment in /etc/passwd
amara is a member of the developers group
